interests: Corporate dramas exploring the tension between maintaining perfection and embracing risky growth, featuring characters who must overcome fear of failure to transform stagnant organizations into remarkable entities.

Psychological character studies focusing on interpersonal dynamics where protagonists learn to influence others by empathizing with their perspectives and arousing mutual desire rather than relying on force or resentment.

Leadership narratives depicting the spiritual journey of service, where mentors guide individuals through real-life anecdotes to discover that developing people is the highest calling of effective leadership.
